name: Bianyuan Xiangmu
source:
We are the nine missing individuals who returned from a mysterious island in the Atlantic.
We gained "abilities," but not without paying a "price."
We fought for survival and, in the end, overcame everything.
And we will keep fighting—until we’ve conquered even ourselves.
He said all of this was for the sake of evolution.
So now we hide at the edge of the world, reaching out toward a "new world" while trying to uncover the mastermind behind it all.
I am one of them—Isaac Rich.
Or you can call me—
Yichen.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756840/__Living_Island_Project/]steam[/url]]
translation:
我们是九名从大西洋一座神秘岛屿归来的失踪者。
我们获得了“能力”，但也付出了“代价”。
我们为生存而战，最终克服了一切。
而且我们会继续战斗，直到战胜自我。
他说这一切都是为了进化。
现在，我们藏身于世界的边缘，一边向“新世界”伸手，一边试图揭开幕后黑手的身份。
我就是其中一人——艾萨克·里奇。
你也可以叫我——
浥尘。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756840/__Living_Island_Project/]Steam[/url]]
